questions.prompt: What did the family toast over the fire?
questions.evidenceText: Dad made a small camp fire in a safe metal dish. They toasted marshmallows on long sticks over the warm flames.

questions.prompt: What kept the fox from coming back?
questions.evidenceText: The air horn worked. The fox did not come back. Dad DID come — running from the house in his pyjamas, looking very startled.

questions.prompt: Why did the camp still feel perfect?
choices: The sun was warm and breakfast was good.
questions.answer: The sun was warm and breakfast was good.
questions.evidenceText: "CHIPS!" they said. But the sun was warm and breakfast was good and it had been a perfect camp.
